cutover_diff_abi_revision.device_impact: functional: the package targets a different API level and may be rejected

cutover_diff_blob_content.device_impact: functional: data or configuration read at runtime differs

cutover_diff_cm.device_impact: functional: capability routing, program arguments or the runner differ; the component may fail to start or lose access

cutover_diff_cmd_flags.device_impact: performance or functional: see the flag category below

cutover_diff_dylib_renamed.device_impact: functional or size: a second copy of the library can end up in blobfs next to the GN one, and users that look it up by the old name fail

cutover_diff_elf_arch.device_impact: functional: the binary does not run on the device

cutover_diff_elf_dynsym.device_impact: functional: code that looks symbols up at runtime may fail

cutover_diff_elf_interp.device_impact: functional: the binary loads with a different dynamic linker

cutover_diff_elf_needed.device_impact: functional: the binary links different shared libraries and may fail to load

cutover_diff_elf_relro.device_impact: functional: a security hardening of the binary differs

cutover_diff_elf_sections.device_impact: functional or performance: for example a missing `.eh_frame` breaks unwinding and crash reports

cutover_diff_elf_soname.device_impact: functional: dependents look the library up by a different name

cutover_diff_elf_stack.device_impact: functional: an executable stack weakens security hardening

cutover_diff_elf_stripped.device_impact: performance: an unstripped binary is larger, so it takes more storage and page-in time

cutover_diff_elf_text_size.device_impact: performance: a large code size change suggests a different optimization level, LTO or allocator

cutover_diff_extra_blob.device_impact: functional or size: usually benign, but it grows the package and can shadow an expected path

cutover_diff_guard.device_impact: functional: the Bazel package changed after phase 1 and now differs from the GN package in ways phase 1 did not report; for records from before version 2, it changed and was not compared again

cutover_diff_missing_blob.device_impact: functional: a component may fail to start or fail to read a file it needs

cutover_diff_package_name.device_impact: functional: the package URL changes, so components and assembly entries that name the old package no longer resolve

cutover_diff_subpackages.device_impact: functional: a subpackaged component may be missing

cutover_info_ambiguous.device_impact: none: several GN packages share the package name, so the cutover was not compared (unverified)

cutover_info_dual_build_only.device_impact: none: the packages stay dual-built and are not cut over

cutover_info_guard_rebased.device_impact: none: the change was rebased since a version 1 phase-1 record, so the guard was skipped

cutover_info_not_compared.device_impact: none: the packages were not compared, so the cutover is unverified

cutover_info_not_covered.device_impact: none: part of a comparison did not run, so differences there are not detected

cutover_info_phase1_missing.device_impact: none: there is no phase-1 record, so the cutover is unverified

cutover_info_tool_unavailable.device_impact: none: a tool or the check itself failed, so part of the comparison is missing
